buildReady.unnamedProject.description: Email saying a build is ready: stands where the project's name goes when it is not known, as a small label over the headline and before a colon in the subject.

buildReady.subject.ready.description: Email subject: a build somebody asked for is ready. {{app}} is the project's name.

buildReady.subject.notWorking.text: {{app}}: Built, but something isn't working yet
buildReady.subject.notWorking.description: Email subject: a build somebody asked for was made, but part of it failed. {{app}} is the project's name.

buildReady.lead.ready.text: Ready to try. Try it, and approve it if you're happy.
buildReady.lead.ready.description: Email saying a build is ready: the headline.

buildReady.lead.notWorking.text: Built, but something isn't working yet. Try it to see.
buildReady.lead.notWorking.description: Email saying a build was made but part of it failed: the headline.

inviteActivity.firstMessage.description: Email to somebody whose invite link brought a person: that person wrote their first message. {{actor}} is a username, after its @. {{app}} is the project's name.

inviteActivity.joined.description: Email to somebody whose invite link brought a person. {{actor}} is a username, after its @. {{app}} is the project's name.

inviteActivity.joinedSomeone.description: Email to somebody whose invite link brought a person whose name is not known. {{app}} is the project's name.

inviteActivity.joinedUnnamed.text: Someone joined your project through your invite.
inviteActivity.joinedUnnamed.description: Email to somebody whose invite link brought a person, when neither the person nor the project is known.
